media_validation.method: SHA256 of all complete files; ffprobe reads every nonempty compressed packet, dimensions, rates and stream metadata; Ogg parser checks page sequences, lacing and final Theora granule timeline against source frame count; audio format checked against original Bink stream audit.
media_validation.limits: This audit does not decode every video frame again or identify spoken language by ASR/listening. FFmpeg's Ogg muxer omits empty duplicate-frame packets. Four unique intro_a encodes omit the final duplicate picture (~60 ms); their complete audio remains and full A/V cue durations are checked within one source frame. Granule timing is not a count of nonempty coded pictures.

checks.conclusion: Action, world transform, physical flags and phase for tracks with >1 translation/rotation key cover all sampled dependencies; zero/single key tracks are phase invariant. Invalid logic, visibility, enabled state and absent owner invalidate both OBBs and physical layer.

NativeStateActor._transition sets action/flags, samples the pose and calls graph_colliders.refresh before returning. The pair loop and payload snapshots are unchanged; later pairs observe current action/broadphase state. Same-action static pose reuse is correct when physical flags/base are unchanged.

Current source bytes must exist. Magic, source SHA256, payload SHA256, bounded compressed/decoded sizes and dictionary type gate cache use; stale/truncated/mismatched caches fall back to source JSON. bytes_to_var is used without object decoding. Build compiler parses current JSON and verifies the cache round trip before accepting it.

Reverse push/pop produces the same first depth-first descendant for exact generated names; root excluded, duplicates preserve first. Call sites use literal generated names, with no wildcard query behavior required; indexing occurs after scene/material setup and before owner/mesh binding.

independent_review.validation_note: Existing Data8/index19/collision15/VM44/platform10 passes were reported by root. This review read implementations, relevant callers and fixture assertions; it did not duplicate those test runs.

exported_cpu_comparison.method: Three alternating fresh processes per version, one complete eight-chapter round in each; no concurrent test/render tasks
exported_cpu_comparison.scene: Normal spawn and idle game logic; no player input; identical original data and HD settings
exported_cpu_comparison.harness_note: Both version harnesses reference the identical external stage probe because test scripts are intentionally absent from production exports. One initial harness path failure for 0.4 produced no timing data; the already successful 0.3 run is retained.
limits: Headless wall intervals include process scheduling and do not measure GPU rendering.
Only normal spawn idle behavior is sampled, not representative whole-level traversal or combat.
Three processes per version on one shared host are not a hardware-independent performance guarantee.
Collider benchmark deliberately holds a pose unchanged; its isolated gain is not game FPS.
The initial eight-chapter comparison did not fix the random seed; a separate seeded g036 follow-up is recorded for the most variable case.

focused_g036_followup.method: g036 only, three alternating fresh processes per version; identical seed24680, 60 warmup and 1200 sampled frames; no concurrent renders/tests
focused_g036_followup.instrumentation: existing stage probe plus collider snapshots outside the timed sample; no per-frame collider instrumentation or production code edits
limits: Headless normal-spawn idle CPU/wall behavior only; no GPU FPS or entire level traversal claim.
Identical seed controls global random state, not OS scheduler noise; only three fresh processes per version.
Collider counters are recorded outside the timed sample. Old export has no refresh/reuse counters.
Process CPU totals include startup/loading; they are not per-frame CPU timings.

review.confirmed_hot_path: Of17 active peers, thirteen physical actors with static local box tracks and three animated pickups rebuild every sampled frame. The player pose is reused. 19200 rebuilds and1207 cache reuses were identical across all three0.4 runs.
review.code_review: The pose key consists of stored scalar/Transform3D fields, not a newly allocated composite Dictionary/Array/String. On misses it adds property lookup, dictionary lookup, comparisons and cached assignments; existing OBB creation/chain sampling remains. Disabled peers call invalidate_pose rather than inline clearing. Allocation-free engine internals are not claimed.
review.causality_limit: Whole-export comparisons include all0.4 changes and OS scheduling; they do not isolate collider miss-path cost. Three paired p50 differences have mixed signs. Median p50 remains worse while median p95/mean improve. This does not establish a stable collider regression.
review.stage_limit: stage_ms measures chapter loading/setup, not per-frame collider refresh. Existing engine monitor snapshots can include preceding loading.
review.decision: No production edits or further runs. Preserve both full and focused outcomes; do not claim universal improvement or collider hit-benchmark gain as game FPS.

changes.appended_limit: The initial eight-chapter comparison did not fix the random seed; a separate seeded g036 follow-up is recorded for the most variable case.

focused_g036_followup.interpretation: Mixed timing results; no consistent per-pair slowdown or proven whole-game FPS improvement. Success means valid measurements, not a speed target.
